original_test_intent: Flash the approved Mellanox/NVIDIA firmware image to exactly the intended NIC and prove, after one controlled reboot, that the target version is active and the device and fabric remain healthy.
original_method: Inventory each NIC and target PSID/BDF, validate the signed image and vendor-supported command, preserve the current firmware, execute one authorized flint operation with a full log, reboot through OOB control and compare target plus non-target devices.
manual_activity: Engineer supplies the exact device/image/command and authorizes flash plus reboot; recovery owner maintains stable power and OOB/vendor recovery; agent may run only the locked approved transaction.
required_inputs: Exact target NIC BDF/MST name/serial/PSID and current firmware
Signed vendor .bin image, checksum, release notes and current-to-target compatibility
Approved MFT/flint version and exact device-specific command/options, including whether -ocr b is valid
Expected active firmware version and per-device/non-target acceptance matrix
Maintenance window, stable redundant power, independent OOB/console, firmware backup, vendor recovery/RMA procedure and recovery owner
safety_requirements: Lock target identity and validate image signature/checksum plus PSID compatibility before any write
Capture complete current firmware/device/link/fabric health and recovery artifact
Require explicit command-level authorization for flash and reboot; never execute example placeholders or blind -y
Stop on device/image mismatch, flash warning/error, power instability, reboot failure or lost link/fabric/management
Never auto-retry, downgrade, power-cycle repeatedly or invoke recovery without engineer/vendor approval
agent_execution_scope: Collect full per-device identity, firmware, driver, link and fabric baseline
Validate the approved image and execute one exact authorized flint command with complete output
Perform one approved reboot and compare target/non-target firmware plus system health
Do not choose image, target or options, broaden to other devices, retry/recover automatically or issue the verdict
engineer_actions: Approve target/image/support matrix and exact flint options
Authorize the persistent firmware write and reboot with stable-power/OOB/recovery coverage
Review complete flash and post-boot evidence and issue the verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Insufficient and partly mismatched: it changes the named flint/.bin operation to generic mlxfwmanager/.mlxfw language, selects the first interface and truncates authoritative output.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Query and lock the exact MST/BDF/PSID target, run only the approved device-specific flint command against the verified .bin image, preserve full output, reboot once and query every target and non-target device.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Pre-flash version query, flint flash, reboot, post-flash version correctness and 30/30 timing fields are preserved; placeholder target/image and example options remain non-executable until approved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a device-identity-locked firmware change record with cryptographic image provenance, exact option review, one tracked write/reboot and complete target/non-target comparison.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Converts placeholder example commands into a controlled, recoverable firmware transaction and adds non-target and health checks.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: The firmware-flash objective remains explicit; driver installation from the preceding row is not substituted.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A wrong PSID/image/option or power loss can brick the adapter, and activation behavior may differ by firmware family; vendor documentation governs recovery.

project_override_considerations: Project recipe must specify whether -ocr b is supported and whether staged versus running versions require a cold cycle; neither is inferred from the example.
expected_evidence: Command-level authorization, maintenance record and recovery owner
Signed image/checksum/release/support matrix plus flint/MFT version
All NIC BDF/MST/serial/PSID/current-firmware and link/fabric baseline
Complete target query and flash output with exit status and timestamps
Reboot/OOB trace and complete post-boot per-device running/staged firmware comparison
Non-target unchanged proof, network/IB/BMC health, logs and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master explicitly requires a flint firmware flash; DeepSeek's alternative terminology is an inadequate review detail, not an ambiguity in the authoritative source.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Execution is gated on the project-specific image, target, authorization and recovery plan, while static review and continuation remain valid.

review_improvement: Makes the destructive firmware step device-specific, provenance-checked and recoverable while retaining the literal pre-flash, flash, reboot and version-verification coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: A Mellanox firmware tool address such as mlx5_X is not a stable identity by itself; it must be correlated with BDF, serial and PSID because enumeration can change across boots. A successful flint exit also does not prove activation or absence of collateral change, so post-reboot running firmware and every relevant link/fabric plus non-target state must be compared.
